summary: Cleanup plans depend on complete, account-bound index roots and carry guarded operations or an explicit empty plan; content commands require deliberate local file access.
reason: Incomplete metadata, stale plan files, account switches, and implicit or credential-bearing transfers can turn a reviewable cleanup into an unintended Dropbox change.
validated_outcome: Unicode moves, incomplete-root refusal, guarded and empty plans, stale-link labels, account binding, time zones, and content-file boundaries are covered by Go tests.
